description: Broadcast settings now live under Studio Manage: Radio, Green room, and Multicast are separate destinations, with provider setup and activation controls in one place.
Artist settings now separate Branding, Gallery, and Press kit into clear top-level tabs while keeping each press-kit field in one place.
Removed the redundant Connections section from Settings; source imports, exports, and add-on configuration remain available from their dedicated areas.
The Embed add-ons now include hearthis.at, with persisted installation, URL or track-ID configuration, and the official hearthis.at player rendered inline on Listen.
Radio add-ons now keep station configuration changes, including stream sources, metadata, and artwork, and unconfigured stations offer a direct setup action instead of a dead disabled state.

Albums, EPs, DJ sets, and playlists now share one searchable Collections hub with release dates, genres, and public, unlisted, or private visibility; My Library now includes Recordings, Messages has its own destination, and Embeds lives with release tools.
Queue actions now flash and disable while adding, remain marked when a track is already queued, and the bottom player uses clear expand/collapse cues with a quieter icon-only clear action.
Artist Branding now combines profile pictures, channel outlook, a public image gallery, keyboard-controlled fullscreen slideshows, and a promoter-ready press kit with an automatic 10-image limit.
Tahti Radio admin now recognises always-on rotation playback, shows the current track and transport controls, and edits the rotation with the shared drag-and-drop playlist table and total duration.
hearthis.at imports now announce start and completion, link to the imported track or collection, preserve cover art, and prevent the same source item from being imported repeatedly.
My Library is now the single first home for every sound, with discography-style search, visibility and pinned filters, stronger striped rows, highlighted profile pins, and inline pin controls.
Fan subscription settings and Revenue now show active subscribers, monthly net revenue, year-to-date payouts, pending and failed transfers, recent payout detail, and subscriber CSV export.
Studio now opens with clickable summary stats for plays, downloads, and followers, while Go Live and Schedule use smaller dashboard actions that leave more room for the overview.
Registration now asks for an artist name and requires the password to be entered twice, while verification tokens remain in the separate email verification flow.

DSP landing pages now use a simpler artwork-first release layout with year and genre, clearer listening destinations, and no license metadata in catalog listings; license remains in full track details.
Tahti Selects admin now reads the real public stream state, automatically recovers an offline rotation, shows the current track, and provides state-aware stream playback controls.
Go Live now includes a persistent, icon-led Record broadcast switch; completed recordings land in Recordings where they can be edited and released.

Artist Stats now brings plays, downloads, followers, smart-link clicks, broadcast reach, engagement units, top tracks, and an anonymized listener world map into one dashboard, with the same map available per track.

The library now opens with every owned sound in a searchable archive, track pages include waveform playback, editing, and rotation controls, HearThis.at imports preserve cover art, and news posts support optional images and links.
Studio tools are now grouped by task, upload forms share one consistent Nuclear file picker, and user-facing screens no longer expose mock, API, backlog, or environment language.
The Tahti map now includes refreshed screenshots for every Nuclear comparison, a current Mermaid route map, and a plain-language annotation explaining what users can do on each screen.

Production web cutover checks now reject mock-enabled builds, gate review-only diagnostics, publish static and API-fed sitemap routes, update route metadata, and exercise vital journeys with Playwright.

Production callback compatibility now sends Stripe, membership, distribution, social, and source connection returns to the correct in-app destination, while the web image adds a hardened same-origin API proxy and health endpoint.
Radio submissions admin now reads the production list response correctly and requests secure playback URLs only when an auditor presses Play.
Account, membership, and two-factor authentication actions now use consistent Lucide icons alongside their accessible labels.
The expanded queue now keeps every item on one horizontal row, exposes hover and keyboard removal controls, includes Clear queue, and uses a dedicated minimize icon.
Channel scheduling now opens with upcoming local broadcast times and separate date/time controls, while all offline programme settings live together under 24/7 Channel settings.
Live channel pages now give the visualizer more space, emphasize the current title and artist, remove technical preset text and duplicate controls, and show loading, play, or pause state accurately.

Owned tracks now open a complete editor for metadata, optional licensing, explicit private visibility, uploaded or imported cover art, playlists, and duplicate-safe exports, while track-list add controls provide clear queue feedback.

Studio Go Live is now one operational dashboard with rotation now-playing details, remaining-time guidance, listening controls, encoder setup, accurate live bitrate, allowance, and multistream management.
HearThis.at Sources now loads your tracks, DJ sets, and collections for individual or batch import into playlists, including preserving sets as Nuclear collections.
Import and export destinations now live as separate sections under Connections, and Track info can queue duplicate-safe exports to supported connected services.
The player visualization now has a clear minimize control and keyboard toggle, while Alt+1 through Alt+5 provide reliable main navigation shortcuts.
The 24/7 channel playlist editor is now fully organized around playlist source, playback settings, and the active rotation, with direct track management and icon-only ordering controls.
Studio's More tools section now opens the in-client distribution, moderation, events, and embed managers instead of showing a stale not-available warning.
Artists without a channel now stay in the client for channel provisioning, and production OAuth callback URLs return to the matching Sources panel with clear result messaging.
Channel pages now use their reactive Three.js visualizer as a full-page ambient layer behind the content, matching the Tahti channel experience.
Studio Stash now supports granting expiring read or download access to a user or link and revoking active shares without leaving the client.
Account now links directly to in-client membership checkout, password recovery, and security settings instead of sending users to stale production link-outs.
Admin user management now has an organized master-detail workspace for viewing account activity, editing access and membership, handling suspensions, opening profiles, and messaging users directly.
Radio slot booking can now attach a prepared show, opens the episode's listener-facing details immediately after booking, and schedule entries drill into a dedicated public show page.
Buttons now respond immediately to presses, the active Play control changes color, and page navigation uses a smoother reduced-motion-aware transition.
Studio Stream Manager now distinguishes a live encoder from the fallback track rotation and reports a disconnected encoder accurately.
My Library now focuses on populated tracks, albums, and playlists; album and playlist rows open directly, with quieter icon-only actions.
Artist channels now support the full visualizer catalog, with ten distinct audio-reactive scenes that load only when needed.
Channel appearance, account, events, embeds, and moderation are now organized into focused tabs, with clearer selected states and consistent page headings.
Nuclear starts maximized by default
Nuclear Jam remote control now supports searching for music, adding tracks to the queue, and removing tracks from the queue.
Playlists can now be sorted.
Playlists can now be filtered.
History stats tab shows a selection of charts showcasing your listening habits.
Fix bluetooth issues on Linux.
Tracks that failed to resolve their streams now retry with a fresh search when you come back to them. When no streaming provider is installed, the error message now prompts you to install one.
Fix streaming getting permanently stuck at 10s intervals.
Listening history: Nuclear now keeps a history of the tracks you play. Can be disabled in the preferences.
Fix playback stalling at 10-second fMP4 segment boundaries (0:09, 0:19, 0:29...) when streaming via yt-dlp, caused by sub-frame gaps between appended segments
Theme loading performance improvements
Recent searches appear under the search box, with keyboard navigation and one-click history clearing
Search box with clear button, search icon, Escape to clear, and URL sync
Fix audio going silent after about a second over Bluetooth on Linux
Fix yt-dlp playback stalling at segment boundaries (e.g. 0:09, 0:29) when buffered audio drifted past the next segment's start time
Fix marketplace themes resetting to default on restart
Custom title bar for frameless window mode. Enable in Settings -> Appearance
Fix HLS playback failing on Windows with Chromium 147+
We're temporarily switching to nightly yt-dlp due to a regression. This will fix playlist imports.
Navigate to playlists directly from artist pages that have them
Fix the queue getting stuck at the end of some tracks, where playback parked a fraction of a second before the end and never advanced to the next track
Right-click a queue item to see its stream candidates and switch to a different source; picking a failed source retries it
Fix TSX plugins failing with 'React is not defined' unless they imported React manually, and fix stale plugin code being served when an imported file changed but the entry file didn't
The window now remembers its size, position, and maximized state between restarts
Nuclear Jam lets you control playback from any device on your local network. Enable it in Settings -> Integrations, then scan the QR code with your phone.
Fix HLS tracks getting stuck at 0:00 when the queue advances
Fix tracks failing to play in saved playlists and in queues restored after restart by re-resolving stream URLs when they expire
MPD server lets you control Nuclear from MPD clients like mpc and ncmpcpp
Installed plugins are automatically updated to the latest version on startup
Fix legacy playlist import failing when track durations use mm:ss or hh:mm:ss format
Fix source selection being reset to the first available provider on startup
Show an empty state in Sources when no providers of a given kind are installed
Streaming providers can now access full track metadata when resolving streams
Fix paired streaming provider not activating when registered after the metadata provider
Frameless window toggle in settings
Back and forward navigation buttons in the top bar
Theme store for browsing and installing community themes
Discord rich presence integration
Plugins can provide music discovery recommendations based on the current queue
Introduce dark mode as persistent preference
Fix issues with tables being way too wide with longer track titles
Nuclear is now built from source for Flatpak, with new app icons
Fixed album tracks being added to the queue without thumbnails
Dashboard, search, and plugins views now prompt to install plugins when none are active
AUR packages are now automatically updated when a new release is published
Fixed a console window briefly appearing on Windows each time yt-dlp was invoked
Queue items are now correctly restored when restarting Nuclear.
New Sources view lets you switch the active metadata and streaming providers from the sidebar
yt-dlp is now downloaded and updated automatically at runtime, fixing Flatpak and AppImage compatibility
Border width is now themable - advanced themes can set border-width to control all borders in the app
Improved dark mode for all basic themes with better backgrounds, toned-down primaries, and themed borders
Update badge shows download progress and lets you click to update or restart
Social links in settings sidebar (Discord, GitHub, Mastodon, Website)
Fixed repeat, shuffle, and volume for MSE streams
Plugins can import YouTube playlists by URL via yt-dlp
YouTube tracks now play using MSE-based streaming, fixing incorrect duration display and enabling proper seeking
Customizable keyboard shortcuts with settings UI for rebinding
Plugin event bus with trackFinished and trackStarted events
Custom settings widgets for plugins (render React components in settings UI)
Shell API for plugins to open URLs in the system browser
Plugins can use Nuclear UI components (Button, Toggle, etc.)
Fixed plugin settings using wrong storage key (core prefix instead of plugin prefix)
Fixed old audio stream continuing to play when switching tracks or clearing the queue
In-app changelog in settings (What's New tab)
Release pipeline auto-generates GitHub release notes from changelog data
Support importing legacy format playlists (from old Nuclear)
Migrated repository to nukeop/nuclear
Playlist import from URL
Playlist provider adapter view with cover art
Fixed loading status getting stuck on stream resolution
MCP server for controlling Nuclear from AI agents and other tools
Plugin store with browsing, search, and installation
Flatpak packaging
